name: OpenTime
summary: OpenTime is a session-based EA that executes trades at specific market open times, capitalizing on the volatility and momentum that typically occur at the start of major trading sessions. It places pending orders or market orders at predetermined times aligned with session openings such as London or New York. The EA relies on time-based entry logic rather than traditional technical indicators.
summary_zh: OpenTime是一个基于时段的EA，在特定市场开盘时间执行交易，利用主要交易时段开盘时通常出现的波动性和动量。它在与伦敦或纽约等时段开盘对齐的预定时间放置挂单或市价单。该EA依赖基于时间的入场逻辑，而非传统技术指标。
strategy_analysis: OpenTime的策略核心是利用市场开盘时段的高波动性进行交易。入场条件基于固定时间触发，当到达预设的开盘时间点时，EA会自动下单。出场条件通常依赖止损和止盈的设定，部分版本可能包含时间到期平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA通过止损控制单笔风险，但策略高度依赖时段选择的准确性。该策略假设开盘瞬间的方向性波动具有统计优势，但未使用技术指标进行方向确认，存在盲目入场的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of OpenTime leverages high volatility during market session opening times. Entry conditions are triggered by fixed time schedules, where the EA automatically places orders when the preset session open time is reached. Exit conditions typically rely on stop loss and take profit settings, with some versions including time-based forced closure logic. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or account-balance-proportional calculation methods. Money management is handled through stop loss to control per-trade risk, but the strategy heavily depends on the accuracy of session timing selection. The strategy assumes that directional volatility at session opens provides a statistical edge, but the absence of technical indicator confirmation for trade direction introduces the risk of blind entries.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description: 挂单类型（买入止损/卖出止损等）
parameters.description_en: Pending order type (Buy Stop/Sell Stop, etc.)

parameters.name: PendingDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: OrderExpiry
parameters.description_en: Pending order expiration time in minutes

pros: 利用市场开盘时段的高波动性和流动性优势，统计上具有方向性概率
策略逻辑简单清晰，执行规则明确，便于回测和优化
避免了长时间持仓的风险，交易时间窗口有限，资金利用效率较高
时间驱动策略不受指标滞后影响，入场时机精确
pros_en: Capitalizes on high volatility and liquidity advantages at market session opens, which statistically have directional probability edges
Simple and clear strategy logic with explicit execution rules, easy to backtest and optimize
Avoids prolonged position holding risk with limited trading windows, resulting in efficient capital utilization
Time-driven strategy is not affected by indicator lag, providing precise entry timing
cons: 缺乏技术指标确认交易方向，开盘瞬间方向不确定可能导致频繁止损
固定时间入场无法适应不同市场环境，震荡市中开盘突破策略容易失败
挂单可能在剧烈波动时滑点严重，实际成交价与预期偏差大
未包含扩展的加仓或调整逻辑，单次交易失败对整体收益影响较大
cons_en: Lacks technical indicator confirmation for trade direction, uncertain opening direction may lead to frequent stop losses
Fixed-time entries cannot adapt to different market conditions, open-breakout strategies tend to fail in ranging markets
Pending orders may experience significant slippage during volatile periods, causing large deviations between actual and expected fill prices
No scaling or adjustment logic included, a single trade failure has substantial impact on overall performance
improvements: 增加技术指标确认（如EMA趋势方向、RSI超买超卖）作为开盘交易的过滤条件，提高入场胜率
加入波动率自适应机制，根据ATR动态调整止损止盈和挂单距离，适应不同市场环境
improvements_en: Add technical indicator confirmation (such as EMA trend direction, RSI overbought/oversold) as filters for session-open trades to improve win rate
Implement volatility-adaptive mechanisms using ATR to dynamically adjust stop loss, take profit, and pending order distances for different market conditions

risk_points: 无技术指标方向确认，开盘方向不确定时可能连续亏损
开盘时段滑点风险较高，尤其在大新闻发布期间实际成交可能严重偏离预期
risk_points_en: No technical indicator direction confirmation, consecutive losses possible when opening direction is uncertain
High slippage risk during session opens, especially during major news releases where actual fills may significantly deviate from expectations

summary_en: OpenTime is a session-based EA that executes trades at specific market open times, capitalizing on the volatility and momentum that typically occur at the start of major trading sessions. It places pending orders or market orders at predetermined times aligned with session openings such as London or New York. The EA relies on time-based entry logic rather than traditional technical indicators.
